g.text: classifier judges the task to require. Marker area is the group's share of conversations.

g.text: Note: Both axes are model-generated judgements published as means, not measured quantities, and the education estimate is a proxy for task

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: difficulty rather than a claim about who is doing the work. The relationship is weak across groups, which is itself the finding:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: autonomy tracks the kind of task, not its apparent difficulty. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max consumer plans plus Cowork;

g.text: Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is not included here.
